test_title: RRB NTPC - Graduate 2025 (CBT 2) Foundational Full Test - 06
subject: general
question: As per the Constitution of India, who is authorized to transfer the Judge of one High court to another?

options.text: Any of the Judges of the Supreme Court

solution: According to Article 222, The President, after consultation with the Chief Justice of India, transfer a Judge from one High Court to any other High Court.
